rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: In the Declaration of the ANC 50th National Conference the delegates 'salute our outgoing President. Comrade Nelson Mandela', say 'You hand over the leadership of our organisation to a new generation of leaders' and 'Comrade, you take leave of the Presidency of an organisation' building on over eighty years of experience.
